query: I'm evaluating a 48‑year‑old woman. Among female patients aged 43–53 admitted with suspected ACS, what are counts, percentages, and average hospital LOS for initial Troponin T: Normal, Borderline, Elevated?
final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_admissions, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pt.dob) = 1948 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pt.anchor_year) BETWEEN 2005 AND 2010 AND pt.anchor_year_group = 'Suspected ACS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patient_admissions, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pt.dob) = 1948 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pt.anchor_year) BETWEEN 2005 AND 2010 AND pt.anchor_year_group = 'Suspected ACS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / NULLIF(total_admissions, 0) AS proportion_patient_admissions, AVG(icu.los) AS average_los FROM admissions a JOIN patients pt ON a.subject_id = pt.subject_id JOIN icustays icu ON a.stay_id = icu.stay_id WHERE a.hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM labevents WHERE itemid = 837275) GROUP BY a.hadm_id;
